system_overview: band-merch-store is a tiny merch storefront with print-on-demand fulfillment. It is built as a small focused system with Catalog at its core, supported by Checkout (Stripe) and Fulfillment Webhook Handler.

recommended_language.rationale: TypeScript fits the tiny merch storefront with print-on-demand fulfillment workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Catalog as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The tiny merch storefront with print-on-demand fulfillment hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Fulfillment Webhook Handler asynchronously
architecture_decisions.chosen_option: Background processing for Fulfillment Webhook Handler
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Product, MerchOrder, Shipment must persist relationally
Components: Catalog, Checkout (Stripe), Fulfillment Webhook Handler
